name: SwitzerlandVR
summary:
SwitzerlandVR places a relief model of Switzerland and its surroundings in front of you at table height. Move, zoom and turn it with your hands.

– Aerial photo or shaded relief
– Towns, peaks, lakes and cantons with key figures
– Hiking trails and SchweizMobil routes when zoomed in
– German and English

Terrain, aerial imagery, place names, borders and hiking trails come from official swisstopo data (© swisstopo). Hiking routes come from SchweizMobil (Federal Roads Office, cantons, SchweizMobil).
